verified_offline.compression: Oodle; open-source ooz matches all 143 owned decoded textures byte for byte

independent_render_check.method: Runtime-style C++ archive/texture decoder compared with independent numpy deswizzler and texture2ddecoder, including alpha-weighted downsampling

rejected_shortcuts: A loaded LC archive is not a unique live course: multiple variants share it
Saved research/unlocked level is not the selected level of the current run
RouteData string coordinate pairs are not a verified world-to-map transform
Elapsed time along a drawn path is not a measured NEO-ONE position
A static Pokemon encounter reference is not a currently visible live actor
Pointers or guest hooks from another game cannot be reused for Snap
